expect: premise false: DRX materials are generally made in gram-scale quantities by mechanochemical and solid-state methods; scalable routes like coprecipitation are needed (p9.L93-97)
question: Why does the review say DRX cathodes are already produced at scale by coprecipitation?
rendered: The review does not say DRX cathodes are already produced at scale by coprecipitation. It actually states that DRX materials are "generally synthesized in gram-scale quantities using energy-intensive mechanochemical and solid-state methods. Thus, synthesis of DRX cathodes using more scalable routes (e.g., coprecipitation) are needed to better assess their commercial viability."
